notes.title: Release. First updates and news
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482094/4f4c462852929522d765f15f1b47858cf1051ddf.png"][/img]Meet new charismatic heroes in our game! We are making even more bright images so that everyone can find their own image.[/p][p]We have also fixed some bugs and continue to work on improving the game.[/p][p]Subscribe to our news and social networks, soon we will tell you about the nearest plans![/p]

notes.title: Working on a random events system
notes.content: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482094/e0a5271460342735bf64ac74967632ac9ee6e6a5.png[/img]We are working on adding random events during a match. Players will get more unique situations and interesting moments. Each game becomes even more unique. Adapt, outsmart everyone! What awaits you: a blackout or the appearance of an auto turret?

notes.title: Adding facial animations
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482094/0da5bc3847be0a10495a4eb5f65deb5a666e444f.gif[/img]
Hello everyone! We are currently actively adding facial animations to the characters. We want to make our characters more realistic to give you more emotions in the game! You can see how it works in the example. We will add facial expression synchronization with the voice chat in the game so that you can enjoy the gameplay!
Subscribe to our news, would you like to see more news from the development?
